appInfo.name: ALCHM - Trauma-Informed Journaling

description.short: Transform your healing journey with trauma-informed AI journaling. ALCHM provides personalized insights, crisis support, and sacred space for emotional growth.
description.long:
⚠️ NOT MEDICAL ADVICE - For emergency mental health support, call 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)

ALCHM is a trauma-informed journaling platform that provides supportive insights and resources for emotional growth and self-reflection.

🌱 KEY FEATURES:
• Trauma-informed AI that recognizes emotional patterns
• Crisis resource directory and safety tools
• Personalized journaling insights and reflections
• Multi-perspective guidance (Sage, Coach, Poet)
• Privacy-first design with encrypted storage
• Cultural responsiveness and identity affirmation
• Evidence-based wellness tracking

🛡️ SAFETY & PRIVACY:
• Bank-level security measures
• Crisis resource connection (not monitoring)
• No data selling or third-party sharing
• End-to-end encryption for personal content
• Age-appropriate design for users 12+

✨ SUPPORTIVE APPROACH:
Built on trauma-informed principles, our AI provides educational support and reflects your wisdom back to you. ALCHM is designed to complement, not replace, professional mental health care.

🎯 WHO IT'S FOR:
• Teens and adults seeking emotional growth tools
• Individuals interested in structured self-reflection
• People wanting AI-powered insights with privacy protection
• Those seeking culturally responsive wellness support

📱 PREMIUM FEATURES:
• Enhanced pattern recognition
• Extended resource library
• Unlimited AI responses
• Priority customer support
• Advanced privacy controls

⚕️ DISCLAIMER: ALCHM is an educational and self-help tool, not a medical device or therapeutic service. Always consult healthcare professionals for medical advice.
